features.heading: Everything for your job search
features.intro: Tools that take you from a first draft to a tracked application.

items.title: Resume builder
items.description: Fill in a structured form and watch a live preview update as you type.

items.title: Templates and export
items.description: Pick a template and download your resume as PDF, DOCX or Markdown.

items.title: Resume score
items.description: See how complete your resume is and what to improve next.

items.title: AI tailor for a job
items.description: Get suggested changes for a specific job posting and apply only the ones you like.

items.title: Skill match
items.description: Compare your skills with a job description to spot what matches and what is missing.

items.title: Job tracker
items.description: Search, sort and filter your applications by status and label, and create a tailored resume for each one.

items.title: Private by default
items.description: Your resumes and applications are stored per user and only you can open them.

items.title: Role-based access
items.description: Each person sees only the features their role allows.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.intro: Three steps from blank page to organized search.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Create your resume with the guided form, choose a template and export it.

steps.title: Tailor
steps.description: Match your resume to a job posting and review the AI suggestions before applying them.

steps.title: Track
steps.description: Log each application with its status and labels, and keep the tailored resume next to it.

closing.title: Ready to start?
closing.message: Sign in with Google to build your first resume.
